Quality Control Analyst
jobs.description:
### **Summary**

The TRD QC Analyst supports the start-up of new laboratories by implementing analytical capabilities, qualifying equipment and systems, and supporting method validation and transfer activities. After start-up, the role performs analytical testing for method validation and routine QC, ensuring compliance with cGMP, GLP, and Novartis quality standards. The position also supports stability studies, investigations, equipment qualification, and continuous improvement initiatives. During routine operations, the role may require shift-based work according to manufacturing and testing needs.
  
  
#LI-Onsite
  
Location: Ivrea, Italy

### **About the Role**

The TRD QC Analyst plays a key role in establishing and operating Quality Control laboratories that support pharmaceutical development and manufacturing activities. During the laboratory start-up phase, the position supports the implementation of analytical capabilities, laboratory systems, equipment qualification, and method transfer activities. Once operations are established, the role is responsible for executing analytical testing, supporting method validation and verification, and ensuring compliance with cGMP, GLP, and internal quality standards. The TRD QC Analyst also serves as a Super User for laboratory software platforms, providing technical expertise, troubleshooting support, and contributing to system optimization and continuous improvement initiatives.

  
  

**Main Activities**:

  
  

* Collaborate on the validation / verification / transfer / troubleshooting.
* Support the qualification of new equipment according to Novartis and regulatory standards.
* Execute the required analysis in the QC department based on the plans and needs.
* Contribute on investigations of deviations and out of specifications.
* Keep the laboratory cleanliness and order and actively collaborate to maintain the laboratory and related instruments and auxiliaries in the best possible status.
* Support the safety objective of laboratory personnel and propose improvements to avoid accidents.
* Keep the analytical material stock with the aim of guaranteeing business continuity.
* Ensure proper compliance with Good Laboratory Practices and documentation in the inspection tests used.
* Identify problems, needs and areas for improvement of the laboratory. In accordance with this, design, develop and implement projects that allow improvements in quality, safety and performance of the analysis process in the laboratory.
* Ensure that the work is carried out in accordance with the requirements of the Novartis QMS and in compliance with GMP regulations.
* Oversight of external laboratories activities
* Support for inspections preparation.
* Review of SOPs
  

  

**Education**:

  
  

* Degree in Pharmacy, Biology, Chemistry, or equivalent
  

  

**Languages:**

* Proficiency in Italian
* Good understanding (mandatory), fluent in verbal and written desirable.
  

  

**Experience/Professional requirement:**

  
  

* Open and clear collaboration and communication
* Shows the appropriate sense of urgency around given tasks
* Scientific, technical and regulatory knowledge in a specific area.
* Knowledge of cGMP, working knowledge of safety and environmental regulations and guidelines.
* At least 2 years of experience in pharmaceutical companies (or analogue) in equivalent roles.
* Proficiency in the use of laboratory equipment such as pipettes, balances, pH meters, and HPLC systems.
* Preferred knowledge of Chromeleon and GLIMS software.
  

  

**Benefits & Rewards**

  

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

  

**Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: € 30,200 to € 56,000**

  

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

  

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

  

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

**Why Novartis:** Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

**Benefits and Rewards:** Learn about all the ways we’ll help you thrive personally and professionally.
  
Read our handbook (PDF 30 MB)

jobs.title: JUNIOR QUALITY CONTROL
jobs.description:
**Aldea Food Srl**, in Ala (Tn), è alla ricerca di:

**JUNIOR QUALITY CONTROL**
==========================

**PRINCIPALI RESPONSABILITÀ:**

La risorsa sarà inserita all’interno dell’area Qualità e opererà a stretto contatto con il reparto Produzione, con l'obiettivo di garantire il rispetto degli standard qualitativi e delle procedure aziendali durante tutte le fasi del processo produttivo.

La figura seguirà direttamente il processo di produzione, dall'avvio alla conclusione, effettuando controlli e verifiche periodiche sulle caratteristiche qualitative del prodotto e sulle condizioni di processo, al fine di assicurare la conformità agli standard aziendali, alle specifiche tecniche e ai requisiti di sicurezza alimentare.

Il candidato/a che andrà a ricoprire il ruolo di Junior Quality Control avrà le seguenti responsabilità:

* Esecuzione di controlli qualitativi lungo tutte le fasi del processo produttivo, dall'avvio della lavorazione fino al confezionamento del prodotto finito.
* Monitoraggio dei parametri di processo e verifica del rispetto delle specifiche tecniche e degli standard qualitativi definiti.
* Controllo delle caratteristiche organolettiche, fisiche e, ove previsto, chimico-fisiche dei prodotti.
* Verifica della corretta applicazione delle procedure operative e delle istruzioni di lavoro da parte del personale di produzione.
* Rilevazione, segnalazione e registrazione di eventuali anomalie e non conformità di processo o di prodotto.
* Collaborazione con il reparto Produzione e con l'Ufficio Qualità nella gestione delle non conformità e nell'individuazione di eventuali azioni correttive.
* Compilazione e aggiornamento della documentazione relativa ai controlli effettuati, garantendo la corretta tracciabilità delle verifiche.
* Supporto nelle attività di monitoraggio e miglioramento continuo dei processi produttivi, nel rispetto degli standard di qualità e sicurezza alimentare.

**REQUISITI:**

**Hard skills:**

* Diploma tecnico o laurea in ambito scientifico, preferibilmente in Tecnologie Alimentari, Scienze e Tecnologie Alimentari, Biotecnologie, Chimica o discipline affini.
* Preferibile esperienza, anche breve, in attività di controllo qualità, preferibilmente nel settore alimentare.
* Conoscenza di base dei processi produttivi e dei principali controlli qualitativi in ambito alimentare.
* Conoscenza dei principi di igiene e sicurezza alimentare e delle principali procedure HACCP.
* Buona capacità di utilizzo degli strumenti informatici e del pacchetto Office.
* Disponibilità a lavorare su turnazione, compreso il turno notturno.

**Soft skills:**

* Precisione e attenzione al dettaglio.
* Capacità di osservazione e analisi.
* Proattività e capacità di individuare tempestivamente eventuali anomalie.
* Buone capacità comunicative e relazionali.
* Capacità di lavorare in team e di interfacciarsi con il personale di produzione.
* Flessibilità e adattabilità ai ritmi e alle esigenze del contesto produttivo.

**Sede di Lavoro**: Ala (Tn).

**Orario di lavoro**: Full-time, su tre turni (comprensivi del turno notturno).

**RAL**: Da 23k a 27K.

**CCNL**: Alimentari Industria.

jobs.title: Post-Doc Researcher for bioinformatics and multi-omics data analysis in Biomedical research
jobs.description:
Bozen/Bolzano
  
  
Institute for Biomedicine
  
  
The Eurac Research Institute for Biomedicine (IfB) located at Bolzano's NOI Techpark, is dedicated to improving human health through precision prevention research. The interdisciplinary work is focused on the investigation of genetic, biological, environmental and lifestyle factors in order to predict, slow or prevent human disease. The institute established the CHRIS population study [1], a decade-long collaboration with the South Tyrolean Healthcare Service, providing extensive data and biological materials suitable for such research. The IfB employs state-of-the-art labs, scientific computing resources and interdisciplinary expertise dedicated to the investigation of neurological, cardiovascular, and metabolic health. Within the HEALTH3P initiative, conducted jointly with Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin (Prof. Dr. Markus Ralser, Biochemistry and Systems Biology of Metabolism Group and Prof. Dr. Britta Siegmund, Department of Gastroenterology, Infectious Diseases and Rheumatology) we are investigating molecular markers for health in the population, with a focus on cardiovascular, kidney and metabolic health. HEALTH3P represents a foundational step in a broader partnership dedicated to investigate the active processes maintaining health and to develop precision-based approaches for disease prevention.
  
  
The successful candidate will join the HEALTH3P team, and will process and analyze large-scale mass spectrometry-based proteomics datasets [2,3] to investigate molecular signatures for health and health trajectories and to develop predictive models for health outcomes. The work is a close collaboration with Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin. The candidate will work together with senior researchers at both IfB and Charité.
  
  
[1] https://doi.org/10.1093/ije/dyaf064
  
  
[2] https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-021-00860-4
  
  
[3] https://doi.org/10.1038/s43856-025-00856-0
  
  
**Tasks:**  
Data preprocessing of a large proteomics data set generated by high-throughput mass spectrometry.
  
  
Exploratory data analysis and data normalization.
  
  
Perform statistical data analysis and apply machine learning to identify protein markers characteristic of health states and trajectories.
  
  
Dissemination of scientific results through scientific publications and contributions to scientific events.
  
  
**Requirements:**  
PhD in a relevant field of research (Bioinformatics, Biostatistics, or Computational Biology), with typically 0–3 years of relevant postdoctoral experience at the time of appointment.
  
  
Experience in the analysis, quality assessment and normalization of quantitative omics data, preferentially mass spectrometry proteomics.
  
  
Extensive experience in data analysis with R and/or Python.
  
  
Experience in reproducible research.
  
  
Knowledge in statistical data modeling, multiple regression analysis and machine learning.
  
  
Proactivity and the ability to solve problems independently.
  
  
Ability to work in a distributed, multidisciplinary research environment.
  
  
Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
  
  
**We offer:**  
Up to three-year full-time position.
  
  
Gross annual salary ranging from 44.914,14 € to 47.272,98 €.
  
  
**Workplace location:** Eurac Research, NOI Techpark, Via A. Volta 21, 39100 Bolzano, Italy.
  
  
**Benefits and work-life balance:** Eurac Research offers a welfare package designed to support employees’ well-being and work-life balance, contributing to a positive and inclusive working experience in an international research environment. The full and regularly updated list of benefits is available here .
  
  
Access to unique health and omics data from the CHRIS population study.
  
  
Collaboration with multidisciplinary international scientists.
  
  
Close collaboration and regular interactions with partners at Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin.
  
  
**Employment conditions:**  
**Employment classification and applicable collective agreement:** II level of the Italian National Collective Labour Agreement for the Tertiary/Commerce Sector
  
  
**Gross Annual Salary range:** the gross annual salary range is primarily linked to the advertised position, its requirements and expected level, and is defined according to Eurac Research’s internal remuneration framework. The candidate’s highest academic degree and any relevant professional experience documented in the CV are taken into account where applicable, but always within the salary range defined for the advertised position. The range also reflects whether the position is full-time or part-time.
  
  
**How to apply:**  
Interested candidates should submit their application (CV, cover letter and further relevant documents) by 30.11.2026.
  
  
**Company :** Eurac Research
  
  
Location
  
: Bozen/Bolzano
  
  
**Contact person :** Francisco Domingues
  
  
**E-mail address :** francisco.domingues@eurac.edu

QUALITY CONTROL SPECIALIST
jobs.description:
**Chi siamo**

Grissitalia Srl è una realtà solida e in continua evoluzione nel settore della panificazione. Crediamo fermamente che il nostro successo passi attraverso il valore delle persone e l’efficienza dei nostri processi. Per questo, siamo alla ricerca di professionisti motivati e competenti che vogliano unirsi al nostro team e contribuire alla gestione quotidiana dell’azienda.

**Il tuo ruolo in azienda**

All’interno del dipartimento Qualità, sarai il garante degli standard di eccellenza dei nostri prodotti. Il tuo compito sarà monitorare ogni fase del processo produttivo, assicurandoti che ogni prodotto finito rispetti rigorosamente i parametri di sicurezza alimentare e le specifiche qualitative che contraddistinguono il brand Grissitalia.

**Le tue attività principali:**

* **Controllo Processo:** Monitoraggio costante dei parametri di produzione sulle linee e verifica del rispetto delle procedure HACCP.
* **Gestione Non Conformità:** Identificazione di eventuali anomalie, gestione dei blocchi merce e supporto nella definizione delle azioni correttive.
* **Documentazione:** Compilazione della modulistica di controllo e aggiornamento dei registri di qualità.
* **Audit e Standard:** Supporto nella preparazione dei controlli per il mantenimento delle certificazioni aziendali (es. IFS, BRC, ISO…).

**Profilo ricercato**

Cerchiamo una figura attenta ai dettagli, con un forte senso di responsabilità e la capacità di intervenire con prontezza in ambiente produttivo.

* **Background:** Laurea in Scienze e Tecnologie Alimentari, Biologia, Chimica o Diploma tecnico (es. Perito Chimico/Agrario).
* **Esperienza:** Gradita esperienza pregressa (anche breve) nel controllo qualità, preferibilmente nel settore alimentare o chimico-farmaceutico.
* **Skill tecniche:** Conoscenza delle normative HACCP e degli standard di igiene e sicurezza alimentare.
* **Attitudini:** Precisione metodica, capacità di lavorare in team e spiccata attitudine al problem solving operativo.

**Cosa offriamo**

* **Contratto:** Tempo Indeterminato/Apprendistato (commisurato all’effettiva esperienza).
* **Range RAL:** € 22.000 – € 28.000 (commisurata all’effettiva esperienza).
* **Sede di lavoro:** Prato Sesia (NO)

Pensi di essere la persona giusta? Se vuoi portare il tuo valore nel nostro team, inviaci il tuo CV a: lavoro@grissitalia.it

*La selezione rispetta il principio delle pari opportunità (L. 903/77).*

**Job Requirements**  

**Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.**

At Siemens Healthineers (SHS) Radiopharma, we are committed to driving sustainable progress through cutting-edge technology. We empower our customers by bridging the physical and digital worlds—enhancing the way we live, work, and move, today and for future generations.

We believe that business success begins with our people. That’s why we prioritize a culture where individuals thrive. Our diverse team is ready to support, inspire, and challenge you to grow in new and meaningful ways. Together, there are limitless possibilities of where our shared journey may lead.

As the global leader in the supply of positron emission tomography (PET) radiopharmaceuticals, SHS Radiopharma pioneered the commercial PET radiopharmacy model over 30 years ago—and continues to shape the future of molecular imaging.

Join us as a **Quality Control Technician**, based in **Meldola, Italy** and help us shape the future of precision theranostics while advancing patient care.

Your responsibility within the Quality Control Laboratory will be to ensure analytical activities, processes, and equipment comply with established quality standards, internal procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.

**Location** : Meldola

**Type of contract:** Permanent

**Your role :**

* Conduct batch analyses following approved SOPs.
* Manage the preparation of solutions, reagents, standards, and routine lab materials.
* Partner with the QC Manager on CAPA implementation and follow-up for lab areas and equipment.
* Assist external technicians with onsite maintenance, calibration, and qualification activities.
* Run routine calibration and validation protocols for QC processes and equipment in line with regulatory requirements.

**The position involves rotating morning and night shifts.**

 **Work Experience**  

**Your profile:**

  

* Technical diploma or degree in Chemistry, Biology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related field.
* 1–3 years in Quality Control or Analytical laboratory roles within GMP-regulated environments.
* Previous experience in radiopharmaceutical companies and proficiency in both the local language and English (written and spoken).
